text: Open-issue line reads 'auth  certificate 74%  -60%/min left' - the trailing '-60%/min left' is unreadable (is it a rate? time left?). Over 5 s of game time (pt wait 5) auth went 74->68%, about 72%/min, so the number does not match a rate either. Also the helper line 'Kofi is helping: on the way up, 2:30 left' stayed at 2:30 across the 5 s wait; unclear if the clock starts on arrival.

Helper never arrives: after ~40 s of game time (pt hold w 6, pt hold e 4+3, pt wait 5, pt wait 20) the HUD still reads 'Kofi is helping: on the way up, 2:30 left' and no figure is visible on the path down to the town. The countdown never ticks. Expected Kofi to walk up and reach me, or the 2:30 to count down. (Also: earlier '-60%/min left' - I now read 'left/right' as the side of the boulder the issue is on; that is not explained anywhere.)

Open-issue line clipped at the right edge on the 0.3 terrace: 'billing  drift  82%  -35%/min under: roll' - the rest (presumably 'roll it back') is cut off at 640 px. Also, on shipping 0.3 Kofi's line still reads 'on the way up, 2:30 left' ~70 s of game time after load.

Correction to kofi-stuck: Kofi was there all along. Once the boulder reached the 0.3 terrace, the line changed to 'Kofi is helping: patching search, 2:29 left' and he is visible beside Sisyphus in the V camera. So 'on the way up' meant 'climbing with you, not working yet', and the 2:30 stays frozen until he can work. In first person he is never on screen, and 'on the way up' reads as 'still coming up from the town'. Suggest e.g. 'Kofi is climbing with you (helps on terraces), 2:30 of help left'.

Helper timer is inconsistent: on the first slope (0.2->0.3) it sat at 2:30 for ~70 s ('on the way up'), but on the second slope it counts down while pushing (1:58 -> 1:43 in 15 s of pushing, 'waiting for it to settle'), so his help drains while he cannot patch. The helper line also clips at the right edge ('1:43 lef').

Good: when Kofi's timer ran out the toast said 'Kofi moved on. Nobody else knew how search worked.' and search immediately opened a drift issue - a clear, funny bus-factor moment. Before that the line '0:33 left' counted down cleanly. Minor: the moment he leaves the helper line just vanishes from the HUD; there is no visible figure walking away in first person.

History (Tab) mid-climb shows one row 'now 0.x 4 10 230 5 0 0 0 1' plus 'No climb has finished yet. Each one that does leaves a cairn at the trailhead.' It does not tell the story of this climb: no 0.3/0.4 release moments, no mention of Kofi by name, what he patched, or that he left and search broke. 'patched 5' is ambiguous - Kofi patched ~7 modules and I patched 4-5, so it seems to count only mine. 'helpers 1' is the only trace of him. The table has no backdrop (drawn straight over the 3D scene) and the header runs to the right edge.
